```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Resolve the directory containing this QMD so relative paths work whether
# rendered from the project root (via targets) or from inside the folder.
qmd_dir <- if (dir.exists("quarto_reports/mouseforecast.com")) {
  "quarto_reports/mouseforecast.com"
} else {
  "."
}
map_png <- file.path(qmd_dir, "email_map.png")

# Written alongside email_map.png by raw_data_update.qmd's fig-aez chunk
# (same cap_aez text used under the AE zone map in the main report).
map_caption <- paste(readLines(file.path(qmd_dir, "email_caption.txt")), collapse = " ")

r_path <- if (dir.exists("r")) "r" else "../../r"
source(file.path(r_path, "a_season_info.R"))
```

::: {.email-body}

::: {.email-preamble}

Hi all, 

A new Mouse Forecast is available, along with some changes to the way we communicate these updates.

**We have launched a new website - [www.mouseforecast.com](https://mouseforecast.com) - where you can see the full report with the most up-to-date information.** 

We will regularly refresh the website as new data comes in (and continue to send these emails at key times of the growing year, the next due in Spring).

A pdf version of the forecast is also attached to this email, please forward on to your relevant network. 

Mouse activity estimates are now completely based on quantitative data. Live-trapping, active burrow, and chew card assessments are integrated with farmer observations via [MouseAlert](https://feralscan.org.au/mousealert). We have kept the same "traffic light" colour coding but shifted to a continuous scale to show detail. 
We are actively refining statistical methods to improve these forecasts and their presentation. Please let us know if you have any feedback. 


Cheers, Matt.

<div class="email-signature">
<strong>Dr Matthew Rees</strong><br>
Research Scientist | CSIRO | <a href="mailto:matt.rees@csiro.au">matt.rees@csiro.au</a>
</div>

:::

## Overview

```{r}
#| label: fig-aez
#| results: asis

# Embed the PNG as a plain <img> tag with an inline base64 data URI, bypassing
# Quarto's figure wrapper (which adds a lightbox link and scroll controls).
# map_caption (read from email_caption.txt in the setup chunk) is the same
# cap_aez text shown under the AE zone map in the main report.
cat(sprintf(
  '<img src="%s" style="width:100%%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px auto 0;" alt="Mouse activity map" />
   <p style="margin:8px 0 0;font-size:0.82em;color:#666666;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.5;">%s</p>',
  knitr::image_uri(map_png),
  map_caption
))
```
